# interfere_public_key (Resource)

Manage a surface's publishable key. Configuration changes replace the key and require a fresh idempotency_key. Import using workspace-slug/surface-slug/key-uuid. External rotation refreshes content; destruction revokes the key and its rotation grace-period values.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `idempotency_key` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `surface_slug` (String)
- `workspace_slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Publishable credential for browser SDK configuration.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
